# Healthy Life Essentials & Wellness Herbals

> Doctor-formulated herbal remedies, teas, tinctures, capsules, feminine wellness products, and natural wellness kits made in Nigeria.

## Brand and locations

Healthy Life Essentials & Wellness Herbals is a Nigerian herbal wellness brand founded by Dr. Kolawole Oluwatomisin Esther. The headquarters are in Ado-Ekiti, Ekiti State, where products are formulated and packed. Lagos is the dispatch hub for courier handoff, consultations by appointment, and international shipping coordination. Orders are delivered across Nigeria and worldwide through courier partners.

## Safety

Product pages and consultations should be reviewed before use. Herbal products are not a substitute for emergency care or a diagnosis from a qualified healthcare professional. Customers should disclose medications, pregnancy, breastfeeding, allergies, and medical conditions before starting a therapeutic protocol.
